Lines: It appears someone has reassembled our idol, dearest Daybringer.

Pages.Speaker: Daybringer
Lines: It appears so. Little one, you have impressed us greatly.
Could they be the one we've been searching for..?

Pages.Speaker: Daybringer
Lines: Young one. We would like to provide you with one last test.
A test of strength against us.
When you are ready, call us forth with the worm statue in your hand.

Pages.Speaker: Daybringer
Lines: We will be able to find you because of these beacons you reactivated.
Do not expect us to go easy on you, {0}.[Pause(2)]
